description: F1 development channel. Not production-ready; expect breaking rebuilds.
expected_image_references_note: Repositories (no tag) that identify the Enthroned channel. Empty until the registry namespace exists (ADR-0002); while empty the Settings treats the origin as unverified and still blocks generic Fedora/CentOS images. Once filled, any other origin blocks system updates.
publish_policy: Publishing to a registry is disabled in F1 until a namespace and signing keys are configured by a human (ADR-0002).
